source_authority: existing hourly Powerhouse repository janitor GitHub completed jobs
root_cause: Existing p50/p95 CI job telemetry and agent priorities had no standard, exact-commit-task evidence projection usable for consistent cross-agent comparisons.
fix: Add bounded, local OpenTelemetry CI/CD semantic-convention field projection over the same completed GitHub job sample; no additional provider request, scheduler, exporter, queue or side effect.
prevention: Project only completed jobs with validated IDs, 40-character source SHA, real timestamps and bounded task names. Never claim critical path, SLA, delivery or production readback from a sampled CI job set. Suppress the entire projection on partial provider reads or insufficient independent samples.
